meta.methodology: Read framework.md, torah_60_packages.json, all reference===60 edges from torahData.js, and the full source text torah_60.txt. For each בְּחִינַת / הַיְנוּ / נִקְרָא statement in the source text, verified whether both sides of the equivalence appear as nodes in the dataset. Only concepts with explicit bechina language were considered. Pure eitza (causal) statements, verse-citations used as proofs, and narrative interpretive glosses were excluded. The source text covers 105 lines including an extended Talmudic story (Choni HaMe'agel) that the Rebbe decodes paragraph by paragraph.
